description: Explore financial statements published by Brazilian companies. Search by company name or CNPJ, view company profiles, balance sheets and income statements, compare company rankings, and read publications with links to source documents on Balanços.AI. Financial figures are shown in Brazilian reais, with reporting periods and available data update dates. Coverage is expanding, and some periods or documents may be unavailable. A Balanços.AI account is required. Queries generate operational logs and private usage history, with usage history retained for 90 days.

defaultPrompt: Analise os balanços e resultados mais recentes disponíveis da Globo Comunicação e Participações.
